attributes.action: Reform police investigations: fairness, accountability and welfare
attributes.additional_details: Police officers must be held accountable, but those under investigation are also entitled to a fair, impartial and timely process. Lengthy suspensions and investigations can severely affect officers and their families. We want stronger oversight of investigators, safeguards around evidence and conflicts of interest, meaningful suspension reviews, reasonable timescales, and independent welfare and mental health support for officers and their families throughout the process.
attributes.background: Review and reform police suspension and investigation procedures to ensure timely, fair and thorough investigations, independent oversight and accountability of investigating officers, regular suspension reviews, and consistent welfare and mental health support for officers and their families.

rejection.details:
We can't publish petitions when the request is something that's already happening or something that has been announced since you started your petition.

We think your petition is covered by Government or Parliament action already. An end-to-end review of the police accountability is already underway:

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/end-to-end-review-of-the-police-accountability-system

You may wish to start a new petition focusing on any areas not covered by this review.
